title: Class 3 'blob': a Pepto-Bismol-colored cloud with a golden core that vibrates

tellings.quote: Class 3 is a "spot." Yes. I describe it as a cloud. Pepto-Bismol color.

plain: James Valor, of Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call up UFOs, describes one kind of object his team has seen: what they call a "Class 3", a "spot" that looks like a cloud of "Pepto-Bismol color" with a golden core that vibrates. Valor tells Michels he saw these himself during the company's operations between 2021 and 2025, and if he is right it would be a type of unexplained object that shows up again and again.
